audience: developers and product teams who build symptom checkers on the Infermedica medical model

useCases.title: Look up a symptom, condition or risk factor
useCases.text: The AI opens a single symptom, condition or risk factor by its id from the Infermedica medical model and explains what the entry contains.

useCases.title: Find the concept id for a phrase
useCases.text: The AI searches the medical concept database for observations that match a phrase (autocomplete) and returns the matching concepts and their ids.

useCases.title: Browse the symptoms, conditions or risk factors in the model
useCases.text: The AI lists all symptoms (optionally for an age), conditions or risk factors in the medical model, so you can see what the model covers.

useCases.title: Browse lab tests and their results
useCases.text: The AI lists the lab tests in the medical model with their possible results, or opens one lab test by id.

useCases.title: Check the version and size of the medical model
useCases.text: The AI reads the model metadata: version, last update and concept counts. Useful before you test or update an integration.
